adjudication.rationale: In `packages/app-store/googlecalendar/lib/CalendarService.ts` both `updateEvent` and `deleteEvent` now compute a calendar id as `externalCalendarId ? externalCalendarId : event.destinationCalendar?.find((cal) => cal.externalId === externalCalendarId)?.externalId` (similarly at the later `calendarId` assignment). When `externalCalendarId` is falsy (the only time the `find(...)` branch runs), the predicate compares `cal.externalId === externalCalendarId` (i.e., `=== undefined/null`), which will not match any normal destination calendar externalId, so it will almost always return `undefined`. This makes the fallback branch effectively broken/unreachable for selecting a destination calendar, and is a concrete correctness defect introduced by this diff.
